title: Thread-Safe Queue with Shutdown (lidar → odometry)
hints: Members: `std::mutex m_; std::condition_variable cv_; std::deque<T> q_; bool shutdown_ = false;`
pop: `std::unique_lock lk(m_); cv_.wait(lk, [&]{ return shutdown_ || !q_.empty(); });` The predicate handles spurious wakeups.
After the wait: if `q_` is empty it must be because of shutdown, so return `std::nullopt`; otherwise move out the front.
shutdown() sets the flag under the lock, then `cv_.notify_all()` so EVERY blocked consumer wakes up. push uses notify_one.
